verdict.rationale: Jira's docs mention customizable fields/workflows and connecting engineering, product, and marketing initiatives across teams, which supports status/priority tracking and cross-team ownership at a basic level, but no evidence explicitly shows a dedicated 'initiative' object with a formal owning-team field. Community feedback (jira-comm-5, jira-comm-12) confirms cross-team linking works but also notes admin overhead and complexity in large-scale tracking. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an 'initiative' hierarchy level, a formal 'owning team' field, and independent verification of this specific workflow in practice.
